hook: Don't keep your SSH keys on disk
hookText: Don't keep your SSH keys on disk

beats.say: Storing SSH keys as plain files on disk is riskier than it looks; this post explains the threat and what to do instead.
To just make this absolutely clear, this means that the private keys are vulnerable to be exiltrated by malicious code scanning my disk.
After reading articles like I deleted all my SSH keys, I finally decided to take the next step and get them off disk.
